name: RiskManager_with_InfoPanel_and_Support
summary: This EA is a risk management utility that monitors open positions and calculates risk metrics, displaying them on an info panel. It provides support functions such as trailing stops, breakeven adjustments, and partial close capabilities without generating its own trade signals.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个风险管理工具，监控持仓并计算风险指标，通过信息面板展示。它提供追踪止损、保本调整和部分平仓等辅助功能，不生成自主交易信号。
strategy_analysis: 从文件名推断，该EA是一个风险管理工具而非自主交易策略。它不基于任何技术指标或信号逻辑自主开仓，而是对已有持仓进行风险控制。入场条件不适用于此工具，因为它不主动入场。出场条件主要体现在追踪止损、保本移动和部分平仓等风险管理功能上。仓位管理方面，它可能提供固定比例或固定金额的风险计算功能，帮助交易者控制每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理功能包括账户整体风险监控、最大回撤限制以及持仓比例展示。信息面板可能实时显示账户余额、净值、已用保证金、可用保证金、浮动盈亏及风险比例等关键数据。
strategy_analysis_en: Based on the filename, this EA is a risk management utility rather than an autonomous trading strategy. It does not open positions based on any technical indicators or signal logic. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not initiate trades independently. Exit conditions are primarily implemented through trailing stops, breakeven adjustments, and partial close risk management features. Position sizing may include fixed-percentage or fixed-amount risk calculation to help traders control risk exposure per trade. Money management features likely include overall account risk monitoring, maximum drawdown limits, and position ratio display. The info panel probably shows key metrics such as account balance, equity, used margin, free margin, floating P&L, and risk ratios in real time.

parameters.name: BreakEvenProfit
parameters.description_en: Profit points to trigger break even

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，0表示管理所有订单

pros: 提供全面的风险管理功能，帮助交易者控制每笔交易和整体账户的风险敞口
信息面板实时展示关键账户指标，提升交易决策透明度
支持多种出场管理方式（追踪止损、保本、部分平仓），灵活适应不同交易场景
pros_en: Provides comprehensive risk management features to help traders control per-trade and overall account risk exposure
Info panel displays key account metrics in real time, improving trading decision transparency
Supports multiple exit management methods (trailing stop, breakeven, partial close) for flexible adaptation to different trading scenarios
cons: 作为工具型EA不产生自主交易信号，完全依赖人工或其他EA的开仓决策
缺乏市场波动性过滤器（如ATR自适应止损），止损参数为固定点数可能在波动变化的市场中不够灵活
信息面板可能在频繁刷新时消耗资源，影响交易服务器通信性能
cons_en: As a utility EA it does not generate autonomous trade signals, relying entirely on manual or other EA entry decisions
Lacks volatility filters (e.g., ATR-adaptive stops); fixed-pip stop parameters may be inflexible in varying market volatility
Info panel may consume resources during frequent refreshes, potentially affecting trade server communication performance
improvements: 增加ATR自适应追踪止损功能，使止损距离能根据市场波动性动态调整
添加基于时间的风险管理规则，如新闻事件前自动收紧止损或禁止新开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive trailing stop functionality so stop distances dynamically adjust based on market volatility
Implement time-based risk management rules such as automatically tightening stops or prohibiting new positions before major news events

risk_points: 作为工具型EA本身不执行自主交易，风险较低
若MagicNumber设为0管理所有订单，可能意外修改其他EA的持仓止损
risk_points_en: As a utility EA it does not execute autonomous trades, inherent risk is low
If MagicNumber is set to 0 to manage all orders, it may inadvertently modify stop levels of positions opened by other EAs

summary_en: This EA is a risk management utility that monitors open positions and calculates risk metrics, displaying them on an info panel. It provides support functions such as trailing stops, breakeven adjustments, and partial close capabilities without generating its own trade signals.
